role: P2b REDESIGN #1 (of a 2-redesign budget). Fixes the two failures the v21 calibration exposed: a density-confounded short pole and a finite-size-collapsed reach_score. The OBSERVABLE is unchanged (bucketing; hand-count tests pass) — only the poles and the reach_score aggregation change. Sealed before re-measurement.
extends: v21 (point-to-set instrument). v21's NOT_QUALIFIED under its metric STAYS ON THE RECORD. This is redesign #1; a second NOT_QUALIFIED after redesign #2 => INSTRUMENT NOT QUALIFIED, propagation line stops.

failure_1_reach_score_finite_size.what_broke: reach_score = 'signal at the LARGEST valid radius' (v21 R-3) lands in parity's FINITE-SIZE-COLLAPSED regime: on n=16 the far boundary at large r is a small set that cannot span the affine coset, so parity's signal drops to 0 by r=4 (0.40 @ r1 -> 0.0 @ r4). The metric read parity's collapse, not its reach.
failure_1_reach_score_finite_size.the_fix: reach_score RE-PINNED = point-to-set signal at the FIXED radius r=2 — the near-boundary DISCRIMINATING regime. r=1 is near-trivial (its boundary is the whole instance minus i); large r collapses on small n; r=2 (boundary excludes i's immediate neighbours, keeps the distance->=2 context) is where local (bounded-width, short) separates from global (affine, long). This is a redesign of the metric, permitted ONCE as redesign #1, with the finite-size rationale stated; the OLD metric's result is not erased.
failure_1_reach_score_finite_size.sensitivity_only: the persistence ratio signal(r2)/signal(r1) and the area-under-curve MAY be reported as sensitivity, NEVER substituted for the pinned r=2 signal after seeing results.

failure_2_density_confounded_short_pole.what_broke: the v18 short pole (2-SAT at LOW density alpha=0.4) read HIGH at every radius (0.32-0.40). Low density -> the variable graph fragments into small components -> the 'far' boundary sits INSIDE the target's own small component and determines it -> high signal. 'Low density => short reach' is empirically WRONG for point-to-set.
failure_2_density_confounded_short_pole.the_fix: ALL poles CONNECTED (moderate-to-high density, one giant component), so the far boundary is genuinely far.

poles_v22_all_connected.long_parity: 3-XOR parity @ alpha=0.6 (SAT regime, rich coset) — must read HIGH (at the top).
poles_v22_all_connected.consistency_affine: 2-affine equality @ alpha=0.6 — globally rigid; reads HIGH, near parity (consistency).
poles_v22_all_connected.bounded_width_b: 2-SAT @ alpha=1.6 (denser, more connected) — bounded-width; must read LOW (tests that bounded-width stays low across density, not that it forms a distinct middle level).

pass_criterion_honest_to_the_dichotomy.note: point-to-set reach on Boolean CSP is essentially DICHOTOMOUS (bounded-width = short/local; affine/parity = long/global) — the algebraic dichotomy predicts this, so a clean 3-level ordering may not exist. The criterion tests the GROUP separation (the corr-inversion), not a strict 3-rank.
pass_criterion_honest_to_the_dichotomy.criterion: at r=2: the AFFINE/PARITY group {3-XOR, 2-affine} reads HIGH and the BOUNDED-WIDTH group {2-SAT@0.9, 2-SAT@1.6} reads LOW, with NON-OVERLAPPING bootstrap intervals BETWEEN the groups, and PARITY AT THE TOP. This is the exact inversion of corr (which put parity at the floor).
pass_criterion_honest_to_the_dichotomy.qualified: groups separate (min HIGH interval > max LOW interval) and parity at top -> QUALIFIED.
pass_criterion_honest_to_the_dichotomy.not_qualified: groups overlap, or parity not at top -> NOT_QUALIFIED (redesign #2 available, else INSTRUMENT NOT QUALIFIED).

unchanged: the observable + bucketing (hand-count sensitivity/specificity tests still gate it)
resolution floor: MIN_SOLUTIONS=16, MIN_BUCKETS=4; population report per cell; below-floor => unmeasurable
n=16 (exact coset enumeration); larger-n is redesign #2 if the finite-size limit still bites at r=2
standing_discipline: metric re-pinned ONCE as redesign #1 with a stated finite-size rationale — NOT metric-shopping; sensitivity metrics never substituted
v21's NOT_QUALIFIED stays on record; this is a documented redesign, not an erasure
the dichotomy framing is a finding, sealed here before the run, not a post-hoc excuse
